verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Analytics AI (part of Intuit Intelligence) explains in plain language which campaigns and automations drive revenue and why, inside the product. Predictive Segmentation and generative AI features on the pricing page reinforce that AI-driven insights are built in. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the insights and recommendations work, explicit evidence of concrete actionable suggestions beyond explanations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
